g.text: Observed directional gaps are non-monotonic across five checkpoints
Five separate 54-episode DROID cohorts · 27 matched seeds per checkpoint · directional gap = RIGHT success rate − LEFT success rate
No monotonic association is detected in this five-checkpoint descriptive sample. Floor and ceiling compress the observable binary gap.
